name: a one-intent 400 refuses the entry invalid with a notice, rewinds nextN to its n and emits sync-push-malformed
a one-intent 413 refuses the entry too-large with a notice and rewinds nextN to its n
a 413 on three intents answers limit 2, and the next push resends the first two by n
a one-intent 400 on a tag create returns the sent link keyed by it to ready and folds it into the one notice
a 401 pauses the sender and still takes an offset sample
a 409 served as another account is a 401: the sender pauses and keeps its replica id
a 409 account-mismatch pauses the sender and changes nothing: the push named the replica's account under another's credential
a 200 served as another account is a 401: the sender pauses and records none of its results
a hello served as anonymous pauses a bound replica and still takes an offset sample
a 409 re-identifies after taking an offset sample, and the instance takes a new actor
a 400 on two intents answers limit 1 and emits sync-push-malformed, with no notice
a one-intent 400 after halving refuses its entry, rewinds nextN to its n and returns the later sent entry to ready
a sample after the wall clock jumps against the monotonic clock replaces every earlier sample
a sample after a reboot replaces every earlier sample, and a steady clock keeps them
a response to a request that straddles a clock jump takes no sample, and the next sample replaces the earlier ones
hello takes an offset sample
re-identify mints a replica id, restarts n at 1 and returns sent entries to ready, and the instance takes a new actor
a process death between result batches keeps the results recorded; the rest stay sent and ackThrough holds, and the resend is answered from the stored results

a replica with no epoch takes the answer's in its first result batch: after a death between batches, a pull from a restored server of another epoch changes epoch, and the entry acked before the restore returns to ready and is sent again
an epoch change nulls every cursor, returns acked entries of another epoch to ready and re-identifies, and the instance takes a new actor
